title: "Spaceshooter 3", The 3rd game in the series. Bullet hell/roguelike
author: IDontMindMuch
selftext:
I've tried a new workflow with Claude using the /grill-with-docs workflow. Fantastic! This game is playable and open source for those curious. Currently mouse only.

https://casmo.itch.io/spaceshooter-3

https://github.com/casmo/spaceshooter-3

comments.author: IDontMindMuch
comments.body: I use the /grill-with-docs and for some task the /to-prd and /to-issues tools that really help the quality of code. If you wanna know more, you can check this post: https://mathieuderuiter.nl/read/create-a-perfect-ai-colleague/ or check the author of the skills at aihero.dev.
